label: TypeScript language server
_initNote: useSyntaxServer=never: with the default 'auto' tsserver answers definition/hover from the syntax-only server while the project loads (imports resolve to the local alias, not the target file); our router would show that as a wrong location instead of falling back to the index. tsserver.path pins the bundled typescript@6 (typescript 7 is the native port: no tsserver.js).

detect.hint: Optional system fallback: npm install -g typescript-language-server typescript@6
